# Query strings

Reading and building the name-value pairs of a query.

<h2 id="query-pair"><code>QueryPair</code></h2>

```rux
pub struct QueryPair {
    pub name: char8[..];
    pub value: char8[..];
}
```

One `name=value` pair of a query, both still percent-encoded. `Copy`.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Url/Src/Query.rux#L12)

**Fields**

| Name    | Type        | Description                                                    |
| ------- | ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `name`  | `char8[..]` | The name, before the first `=`.                                |
| `value` | `char8[..]` | The value, after the first `=`, or empty when there is no `=`. |

pub struct QueryPairs {
    // private fields

A walk over a query's pairs, in order, skipping empty ones. `Copy`.

The walk itself, so that `for pair in Pairs(query)` reads every pair.

<h2 id="pairs"><code>Pairs</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Pairs(query: char8[..]) -> QueryPairs
```

The pairs of `query`, a query without its `?`, such as the one [`Url::Query`](/docs/api/url/url#query) returns.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Url/Src/Query.rux#L29)

**Parameters**

| Name    | Type        | Description |
| ------- | ----------- | ----------- |
| `query` | `char8[..]` | the query   |

**Returns**: a walk over its pairs

<h2 id="decode"><code>Decode</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Decode(
    allocator: Allocator,
    encoded: char8[..],
    form: bool
) -> String ! UrlError
```

Decodes a percent-encoded component into text. With `form`, a `+` is read as a space, as in a query.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Url/Src/Query.rux#L68)

**Parameters**

| Name        | Type        | Description                                            |
| ----------- | ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `allocator` | `Allocator` | what the text is kept in                               |
| `encoded`   | `char8[..]` | the component, such as a path segment or a query value |
| `form`      | `bool`      | whether `+` stands for a space                         |

**Returns**: the text, or fails when an escape is malformed or the bytes are not UTF-8

<h2 id="query-builder"><code>QueryBuilder</code></h2>

```rux
pub struct QueryBuilder {
    // private fields
}
```

Builds a query from `name=value` pairs, encoding each the way HTML forms do.
Not copied.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Url/Src/Query.rux#L90)

| `allocator` | `Allocator` | what the query is kept in |

**Methods**

<h3 id="append"><code>Append</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Append(
    self: &var QueryBuilder,
    name: char8[..],
    value: char8[..]
) -> ! UrlError
```

Appends a pair, encoding the name and the value: letters, digits, `*`, `-`, `.` and `_` stay, a space becomes
`+`, and every other byte is percent-encoded.

| Name    | Type        | Description        |
| ------- | ----------- | ------------------ |
| `name`  | `char8[..]` | the name, as text  |
| `value` | `char8[..]` | the value, as text |

**Returns**: nothing, or fails when the allocator refused

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Url/Src/Query.rux#L109)

<h3 id="query-builder-text"><code>Text</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Text(self: &QueryBuilder) -> char8[..]
```

The query built so far, without a `?`, ready for [`Url::SetQuery`](/docs/api/url/url#set-query).

**Returns**: the query

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Url/Src/Query.rux#L119)
